newsitem.title: CHINA: China says foreign reserves could rise in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China says foreign reserves could rise in 1997.

text.p: China's foreign exchange reserves have exceeded $100 billion and could rise further in 1997, the official Financial News said on Tuesday.

Reserves hit $100.45 billion on November 12 and could climb further in 1997, said the newspaper, which is published jointly by the central bank, the country's major commercial banks and state insurer.
The reserves had soared by $26.8 billion compared with the end of 1995, the newspaper said, adding that the increase for the whole of 1995 was $22.0 billion, the newspaper said.
